name: Bondtech LGX
description: The Bondtech LGX (Large Gears eXtruder) features oversized drive gears for improved filament grip and a two-stage 44:14, 37:17 gear reduction. Its large contact area with the filament reduces the chance of slipping during high-speed or high-flow printing. The LGX is designed for direct drive use and ships with a custom LDO NEMA17 25mm pancake stepper motor with 14T motor gear.
features: Large diameter dual drive gears for high grip surface area
High gear ratio for precise filament control
Compatible with many direct drive toolhead mounts
